acceptance: If pursued: core's shard-completeness check against medium_shard_durations.json stays consistent; before/after job-minutes and wall time per PR run measured on real runs.
context: Owner 2026-11-19: stay on Free plan. Source: CI throughput investigation.
description:
For consideration, not a required change (owner, 2026-11-19).

Observed: a full PR CI run is 21 jobs at the median, 44 at p90 and up to 100 (4-12 dynamic medium-test shards); setup steps are 15.5% of CI job time; under the 20-job cap more shards do not shorten wall time. PR CI waits ~36 min in queues across its stages (ci-paths -> medium-collect -> medium-test -> core). Three aggregate jobs sleep 90 s holding a runner when a run is cancelled.

Ideas: cap medium-test at about 4 shards while the cap is 20 (ci.yml ~457, ~1162-1172); remove the sleep 90 x3 (~1909, ~1990, ~2035); consider dropping trunk-lane-plain/coverage from PR CI (~1333-1356). Estimated 5-15% of CI runner time [inference].
